items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: Adobe released a critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source to resolve a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe is aware that this vulnerability has been exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This authorization bypass flaw in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged authenticated attackers to bypass a security feature and read select data without user interaction. The vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source across multiple release trains.

items.title: Hackers exploit critical Adobe Commerce flaw to hijack customer accounts
items.summary: Attempts to exploit this critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento e-commerce platforms have been detected, potentially allowing attackers to hijack customer accounts without authentication. This was one of seven issues addressed in a security update.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover (APSB26-92)
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92 as isolated patch files, fixing seven vulnerabilities including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Sansec Shield already blocks this critical issue.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB25-50
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution. An isolated patch was also released for CVE-2025-47110, a stored XSS vulnerability.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: This remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce is caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files. Exploitation requires user interaction.

items.title: NVD-CVE-2026-48358
items.summary: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker with high privileges could exploit this vulnerability without user interaction.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which could lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVE-2026-53787) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution. Amasty has released patches for this vulnerability.
